defense_news.title: Iran attack on base in Jordan damaged American military aircraft, US official says
defense_news.summary: Iranian strikes damaged one A-10 Thunderbolt II and eight F-15s this week on the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan.

defense_news.title: Iran likely to reverse-engineer captured US underwater drone
defense_news.summary: Iran will almost certainly try to pry open the captured drone’s hardware, but the platform's software does carry built-in defenses, analysts say.

defense_news.title: Russia sends bones of medieval warrior prince to Ukraine front to boost morale
defense_news.summary: Bone fragments from the sword hand of a medieval Russian prince who won a famous victory over the Mongols have been sent to the front in Ukraine.

defense_news.title: NATO allies foil Russian subsea cable sabotage plot
defense_news.summary: The clandestine Russian operation was carried out by Moscow’s GUGI undersea warfare directorate to test a destructive sabotage capability, sources said.

geo_news.title: 18 ildeki operasyonlarda 43 göçmen kaçakçılığı organizatörü tutuklandı
geo_news.summary: İçişleri Bakanlığı, 18 ilde göçmen kaçakçılığıyla mücadele kapsamında düzenlenen operasyonlarda 43 göçmen kaçakçılığı organizatörünün tutuklandığını bildirdi.

geo_news.title: Diyarbakır'da depremde 77 kişinin öldüğü apartmanda kolon kesildiği uzman raporunda
geo_news.summary: Diyarbakır'da, 6 Şubat 2023'te meydana gelen Kahramanmaraş merkezli depremlerde yıkılan Serin-2 Apartmanı'na ilişkin hazırlanan yeni bilirkişi raporu dava dosyasına girdi.
